arStrings.szText: Defensive Skill: Smash the ground with tremendous might, stunning all nearby enemies.
{c_important}Ground Stomp{/c} generates {c_number}{SF_0}{/c} Fury and Pulls in enemies.

Casting {c_important}Ground Stomp{/c} also causes your steps to echo additional {c_important}Ground Stomps{/c} dealing {c_number}{payload:STOMP_VariantA}{/c} damage as you travel for {c_number}{buffduration:UPGRADE_A_STOMP_STEPS}{/c} seconds

{c_important}Ground Stomp{/c} no longer Stuns and instead creates an {c_important}{u}Earthquake{/u}{/c} that deals {c_number}{payload:UPGRADEB_EARTHQUAKE_TOOLTIP}{/c} damage and Slows enemies by {c_number}[SF_22 * 100|%|]{/c}.

{c_important}Ground Stomp{/c} becomes a {c_important}Brawling{/c} Skill that deals Fire damage.

{c_important}Ground Stomp{/c} no longer Stuns and smashes the surrounding ground. Instead, it fissures the ground in front of you, dealing {c_number}{payload:UPGRADE_C_STOMP_LINE}{/c} damage. Burning enemies take {c_number}[{SF_35}*100|x%|]{/c} increased damage.
Increases the Fury generated by {c_important}Ground Stomp{/c} to {c_number}[{SF_6}+{SF_8}]{/c}.
